verses.2:
How awesome is the LORD Most High,
 the great King over all the earth!
verses.3:
He subdues nations beneath us,
 and peoples under our feet.
verses.4:
He chooses our inheritance for us,
 the pride of Jacob, whom He loves.
 Selah
verses.5:
God has ascended amid shouts of joy,
 the LORD with the sound of the horn.
verses.6:
Sing praises to God, sing praises;
 sing praises to our King, sing praises!
verses.7:
For God is King of all the earth;
 sing to Him a psalm of praise. + 47:7 Or sing a Maskil of praise or sing praises with understanding
verses.8:
God reigns over the nations;
 God is seated on His holy throne.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
